heading: INT. COURTROOM ABOARD A MOORED RIVER FERRY - DAY

units.text: INT. COURTROOM ABOARD A MOORED RIVER FERRY - DAY
A converted paddle steamer.
The bench is a captain's table.
Brass portholes line the walls, and the floor lifts gently with the river's swell.
JUDGE AUGUSTINE FAIRWEATHER (60s, silver hair, half-moon glasses) peers down from the bench.
At the defense table sit MARCELLA DE LUCA (40s, sharp suit, pearl earrings) and her client, PERCIVAL "PERCY" NAKAMURA (50s, rumpled, calm to the point of serenity).
Across the aisle stands DISTRICT ATTORNEY WENDELL OSEI (50s, booming baritone, fountain pen in his breast pocket).
Counsel, we've been over the manifest three times. Is there any objection to its admission?
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: None, Your Honor.
units.name: DE LUCA

units.text: None, Your Honor.
units.name: OSEI

units.text: They answer at the same time.
Percy glances between them with polite interest.
Then the manifest is admitted, and I would like to thank both counsel for a refreshingly uneventful morning.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: The People have nothing further.
units.name: OSEI

units.text: Nor does the defense.
units.name: DE LUCA

units.text: The Judge removes his glasses and pinches the bridge of his nose.
A gull cries outside a porthole.
The ferry creaks.
Let the record reflect we'll adjourn for lunch.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: He reaches for his gavel.
The courtroom door swings open.
A WOMAN (30s, cargo pants, hair in a braid, a ring of keys at her belt) steps in.
LIEUTENANT SABINE ARROYO, according to the badge on her chest.
She carries a sealed evidence bag in both hands, and she walks the aisle with the careful posture of someone carrying something that might go off.
Your Honor, forgive the interruption. I have a log from the engine room.
units.name: ARROYO

units.text: Lieutenant, I wasn't informed --
units.name: OSEI

units.text: Neither was I. I found it ten minutes ago.
units.name: ARROYO

units.text: She sets the bag on the bench.
The Judge opens it, slides out a bound ledger, and flips to a page tabbed in red.
His face does not move, but his eyes do.
Mr. Nakamura. Were you aboard the Annabelle on the night of March ninth?
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: I was not.
units.name: PERCY

units.text: Then whose signature is this at the foot of the engineer's log?
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: He turns the ledger around.
Percy leans over.
Looks.
Sits back with the same serene smile, though his hand has found De Luca's sleeve.
Your Honor, I'd like a moment with my client.
units.name: DE LUCA

units.text: Your Honor, the People move to continue.
units.name: OSEI

units.text: They speak together again, but this time with an edge, neither yielding.
This is an ambush. ^ OSEI This is evidence.
units.name: DE LUCA

units.text: The Judge raises his gavel and brings it down once.
The ferry rocks beneath it.
Mr. Osei, sit down. Ms. De Luca, you may confer. Lieutenant Arroyo, you will remain exactly where you are.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: Arroyo nods, steps back, and folds her hands.
Percy whispers something to De Luca.
She goes pale.
She looks at the Judge, then at the porthole, then at the river beyond.
Percy. Who is Annabelle?
units.name: DE LUCA

units.text: Percy smiles.
The ferry creaks.
